title: Require Domain Operation Strategy Import Boundaries
forbids: domain operation strategy aggregates or leaves outside their singular default-export and role-specific positive dependency surfaces
why: A semantic module is a router, while each operation strategy is one swappable contract-and-implementation leaf under one local operation. The leaf contract owns strategy configuration without depending on the operation contract; the leaf implementation alone binds both contracts and may consume operation-private algorithm vocabulary. Closing each admitted file to one default authority keeps strategy choice modular and transparent without hidden registries, contract cycles, recipes, adapters, engines, sibling operations, or unrelated implementations.
remediate: Give every aggregate and leaf file one default authority and no named exports. Compose aggregate contracts and implementations only from default semantic leaf entrypoints. Keep a leaf contract on schema/model/policy authorities; bind the default local operation contract, leaf strategy contract, private types, and rules only from the leaf implementation. Compose other operations through the owning router instead of importing their implementations.
message: Strategy dependencies must stay on the positive semantic strategy surface.
